title: Wonderful experience
text: Wonderful experience. Our guide Anime was very informative and interesting. He gave our tour such a rounded approach within historical context and human stories, which he aimed at our personal interests and perspectives. There’s no way we could have learned or enjoyed our day as much had we not chosen a personal guide. Would definitely recommend him.
author: loumC3891PE

title: Alhambra Tour
text: Wonderful tour of Alhambra. Amine is such a knowledgeable tour guide, patient with our picture-taking and full of enlightening stories. I highly recommend him.
author: Deborah_H

title: First class tour.
text:
A first class private tour provided by Amine, who was both very professional and friendly. We were naturally interested in seeing as much as we could, Amine took the time to answer all of our numerous questions, never rushing us when we stopped to take photos also. 
We were highly impressed with his knowledge, we ran slightly over time (our fault)  but he was willing to continue without hesitation.
We would highly recommend his services and this tour - a highlight of our 5 day trip to the beautiful city of Granada and it’s surroundings.
author: 461geraldinel

title: Magnificent visit to the Alhambra with an excellent guide, Amine!!
text:
Excellent visit to the Alhambra which took place in cultural enrichment and good spirits with Amine, a super guide who was very professional and friendly and who adapted very well to the pace of a visit with young children.
Thanks again Amine, we will keep very beautiful memories of our visit for a very long time!!

title: Fabulous guide and place
text: Amine was a wonderful and knowledgeable guide.  We learn so much about the palace and moor culture.  He also knew just where the right paces were to stand for fabulous pictures.  I also appreciated that he was mindful of our need for a somewhat slower pace.   I highly recommend that you request amine.
author: betheb2016

title: Excellent guide to the Alhambra
text: Brilliant from start to finish.our guide was Amine -- a highly intelligent and knowledgeable guide who also understood Arabic so could translate some of the texts.His English was excellent and he was able to explain the history of the Alhambra quite brilliantly. Worth every penny.we were very satisfied customers.
